notes.title: 3.5 - Video update
notes.content: Hello everybody! As you noticed, I didn't make any big update recentely since I am really busy right now. But I finally finished The Last Duskreaper's intro cinematic ! It was a long labour and I was working on the "Golden Alex" version too, for a small videogame contest. Anyway, it was the first time I've made a video project of such scale and it was really funny to create. Hope you'll find this little animation as good as I think it is! A new gameplay video should replace the old and outdated one on the game's steam store page. And as usual, I wish you a pleasant experience on The Last Duskreaper.

notes.title: 3.4 - New Zone, Bugs and Dodge
notes.content:
[u]Hello everyone! I noticed a lot of bugs in the previous version! And on the other hand, I made a big change to the combat system and added a preview of the next zone. So here is the 3.4 and its additions:[/u]

[b]FEATURES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a dodge move (K+J)
[*] Added a system displaying the date and time of each file
[*] Added a small portion of the next area. Probably not representative of the entire area
[*] Best Player Racing Animations
[*] Added a "backup" function to never lose your files
[/list]

[b]BUGS PATCHED: [/b]
[list]
[*] Corner Jump Glitch Fixed - bug that stops the player from jumping against a corner of a wall
[*] Data Eater Fixed - bug causing sudden overwriting of a save file
[*] Slope Soft Lock Fixed - soft locking bugthat occurs when the player was performing a ground pound on a slope
[*] Title Auto Keys Fixed - bug always showing the controls menu at game launch
[*] Roll Block Stop Fixed - bug stopping an attack at every contact with a breakable wall
[*] Level Up Soft Lock Fixed - game crash during level up
[*] Power Menu FPS Drop Fixed - bug causing FPS tdrop when opening the power menu
[*] Start new game black flash - bug making appear a black flash at the beginning of each game
[/list]

[b]KNOWN BUGS :[/b]
[list]
[*] Slowatch Start Bug - bug causing FPS drop each time slow mode is engaged
[*] Music Start Bug - bug causing a delay during transitions between tutorial musics
[/list]

[u]And that’s it for today! If you find other bugs, don’t hesitate to share them with me via discord or steam. Thank you all. And as usual, I wish you a pleasant experience on The Last Duskreaper.[/u]

notes.title: 3.2-Opti Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I had some negative feedback about the game because of its lag. This new update tries to solve this problem with a new system to optimize resources. 

I thank you for your patience and wish you a pleasant experience on The Last Duskreaper!

notes.title: The Last Duskreaper 3.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Following the 3.0 release, I decided to change some small details. Here is the 3.1 and what it changes:
[list]
[*] Upgraded graphisms
[*] Small slow-motion mode related bugs fix
[*] Finally changed checkpoints
[*] Default controller support and preset input table
[*] New prologue end boss
[/list]

And that’s it for today! Thank you all. And as usual, I wish you a pleasant experience on The Last Duskreaper.

notes.title: The Last Duskreaper 3.0 !
notes.content:
The 3.0 is now out ! And, by the way, the Prologue is finished ! I will soon start working on the chapter 1. Here is a list of all the major changes of the game :

[list]
[*] -Slow motion mode for tricky platform moments
[*] -Minor bug patchs
[*] -Multi-language title screen
[*] -Developped story in the first part of the prologue
[*] -Data destroyer bug patched
[*] -Better decoration of all the zones currently accessible
[*] -Stamina regeneration speed buffed
[*] -All Ashley sprites improved
[/list]

Thank you for waiting and I wish you a good experience in The Last Duskreaper!
